acceptance: One page, no more. Covers: the name form `<project>.<id>` and the sanitiser; `project` and `id` labels written at birth; `state` values working/blocked/done/failed and who writes them; freeform tokens and the single-token constraint ([a-zA-Z0-9-_.], no spaces, no prose); absence means unknown; the trust boundary (one user, or a group sharing a socket dir). Every claim traceable to a decision entity; nothing invented.
body: First because the wrapper implements it, and because it is the artefact another person needs to read before the code makes sense. Keep it imperative and short; it is a contract, not an essay.
title: Write VOCABULARY.md from the decisions
